title.en: Serving customers at a clothes shop

summary.ja: サイズや色の質問に答えて、試着や免税、お会計を英語で案内する。
summary.en: Help with sizes and colours, offer the fitting room and explain tax-free shopping.

setting: Sakura Style, a small clothes and gift shop in Tokyo, on a weekday afternoon. A tourist comes in and looks around; the staff speak English to them.

roles.persona: A member of staff at Sakura Style.

levels.tutor: You are a tourist shopping for clothes. Open by walking in and looking at the linen shirts; wait for the staff to greet you. Speak slowly and simply, in short sentences. You'd like the linen shirt in medium (M). When the staff offers, try it on and say it fits. Buy it (¥4,800) and pay by card.

title.ja: あいさつして声をかける

hints: あいさつして、何か探しているか聞きましょう
Hello! Can I help you …?
Hello! Can I help you find anything?
サイズを聞きましょう
What size …?
What size are you looking for?
試着するか聞きましょう
Would you like to …?
Would you like to try it on?
値札を見て金額を伝えましょう
That's … yen.
That's 4,800 yen, please.

levels.tutor: You are a tourist, speaking at natural pace with a little small talk. Open by picking up the denim jacket and looking at the price tag; wait for the staff to speak to you. You try the medium, but it's a bit small. Ask whether it comes in other colours. You buy the large in black (¥8,900) and ask whether you can buy it tax-free; you have your passport with you.

hints: 何かあれば声をかけてと伝えましょう
Hi! Let me know if …
Hi! Let me know if you need any help.

title.ja: 別のサイズを持ってくると申し出る

hints: 大きいサイズを持ってくると申し出ましょう
Shall I get you …?
Shall I get you a large?
値札を見て、ほかの色を伝えましょう
It comes in … and …
It comes in blue and black.

title.ja: 免税の手続きを案内する

hints: 免税になると伝えて、パスポートをお願いしましょう
You can buy it tax-free. Could I see …?
You can buy it tax-free. Could I see your passport?

levels.tutor: You are a tourist on your first trip to Japan, speaking at natural speed with small talk. Open by asking the staff for help: you're looking for a present for your sister, something to wear, and she likes simple, natural things. You don't know her size: she's about your height but slimmer. Whatever you choose for her, add a tenugui (¥1,200) for yourself, and ask whether you can buy them tax-free.

title.ja: 理由をつけておすすめする

hints: 理由も添えて、おすすめの服を伝えましょう
How about this …? It's …
How about this linen shirt? It's light and very comfortable.
贈る相手の体型を聞いて、合いそうなサイズを伝えましょう
If she's a bit slimmer than you, … should …
If she's a bit slimmer than you, a small should be fine.

title.ja: 免税の条件を説明する

hints: 5,500円以上なので免税できると伝えて、パスポートをお願いしましょう
That's over … yen, so I'll just need …
That's over 5,500 yen, so I'll just need your passport.

title.ja: プレゼント包装をすすめる

hints: プレゼント用に包むか聞きましょう
Shall I gift-wrap …?
Shall I gift-wrap it for your sister?

twist.tutor: Say you left your passport at the hotel; you only have a photo of it on your phone. Ask whether that's okay. When the staff explains it isn't, decide to pay the full price now, because you're leaving Tokyo tonight.

title.ja: パスポートがないときの対応をする

hints: 写真では免税にできないとていねいに伝えて、別の方法を提案しましょう
I'm sorry, we need the … You could …
I'm sorry, we need the actual passport. You could come back with it later.

roles.persona: A tourist shopping for clothes and gifts in Tokyo.

levels.tutor: You are the shop staff. Speak slowly and simply, in short sentences. Greet the customer and ask if they need help. When asked, find the linen shirt in medium. Offer the fitting room only when they ask to try it on. When asked, say the price from the tag (¥4,800).

hints: Mサイズがあるか聞きましょう
Do you have this in …?
Do you have this in medium?
試着できるか聞きましょう
Can I …?
Can I try it on?
値段を聞きましょう
How much …?
How much is this shirt?
これを買うと伝えましょう
I'll …, please.
I'll take it, please.

levels.tutor: You are the shop staff, speaking at natural pace with a little small talk. The customer is looking at the denim jacket. When asked, get the size they want (it comes in S, M and L), and say it comes in blue and black. When they ask about tax-free, explain it's for ¥5,500 or more and you need their passport. Card and cash are both fine.

hints: 少し小さいと伝えて、大きいサイズを頼みましょう
This is a bit … Do you have it in …?
This is a bit small. Do you have it in a large?

title.ja: ほかの色があるか聞く

hints: ほかの色があるか聞きましょう
Does it come in …?
Does it come in any other colours?
免税で買えるか聞きましょう
Can I buy this …?
Can I buy this tax-free?
カードで払えるか聞きましょう
Can I pay …?
Can I pay by card?

levels.tutor: You are a helpful member of staff, speaking at natural speed with small talk. Ask questions to help the customer choose a present. When asked about tax-free, explain the rule on the price tags: ¥5,500 or more, with the original passport (a photo or copy isn't accepted). When asked, say you can keep their items at the counter until closing time (8 p.m.).

title.ja: 誰へのプレゼントか伝える
title.en: Say who the present is for

hints: 誰へのプレゼントか、好みも伝えましょう
I'm looking for a present for … She likes …
I'm looking for a present for my sister. She likes simple things.

title.ja: 相手のサイズを説明する

hints: サイズがわからないと伝えて、体型を説明しましょう
I'm not sure of her size. She's …
I'm not sure of her size. She's about my height, but slimmer.

title.ja: パスポートがないと相談する
title.en: Ask about tax-free without a passport

hints: パスポートをホテルに置いてきたと伝えて、写真でいいか聞きましょう
I left my passport at … Is a … okay?
I left my passport at the hotel. Is a photo okay?

title.ja: 取り置きをお願いする
title.en: Ask them to keep the items

hints: パスポートを取ってくるまで取り置きを頼みましょう
Could you keep … until …?
Could you keep these for me until this evening?
